target_observation.scope_summary: Matched NORMAL/LESION/RESCUE public-only cognitive benchmark over accepted WP800; hidden evaluator state excluded; scores are measurements only.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Geiger et al., Causal Abstractions of Neural Networks, NeurIPS 2021, arXiv:2106.02997
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Interchange interventions align model variables with high-level causal variables and experimentally test whether the intervention produces the corresponding counterfactual behavior.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: WP806 conditions should be exact interventions on typed module-state variables, not narrative labels attached after the run.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Meng et al., Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT, NeurIPS 2022, arXiv:2202.05262
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Causal tracing uses interventions on internal states to identify activations implicated in behavior; the work separately tests editing behavior rather than treating localization alone as the final claim.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: A lesion effect and a rescue effect are distinct measurements; neither should be silently promoted into broader editability or whole-system causality claims.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Zhang and Nanda, Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models, 2023, arXiv:2309.16042
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Activation-patching conclusions can change materially with corruption method and evaluation metric; the standard design uses clean, corrupted and restored/patched passes.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: WP806 must bind intervention construction and metric identity in the receipt; corruption/lesion method is part of the experiment identity, not an implementation detail.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Vaidyanathan et al., The Curse of Multiple Mediators: Hidden Interaction Effects in Activation Patching, arXiv:2606.27510, 2026
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Single-component patching can mix path-specific effects with interactions and can miss or inflate components whose effects depend on other components; multi-component interactions are not predictable from isolated scores alone.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: A small single-lesion delta cannot establish irrelevance. WP806 should preserve an explicit REDUNDANCY_OR_INTERACTION_UNKNOWN outcome and optionally escalate to bounded predeclared co-lesion tests rather than forcing a zero-effect conclusion.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Gong et al., Conditional Co-Ablation: Recovering Self-Repair Backups in Transformer Circuits, arXiv:2607.01940, 2026
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Self-repair can make an important primary component appear weak under isolated ablation because backup components become active only after the intervention; conditional co-ablation exposes these backups in the studied transformer circuits.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: WP806 should treat compensation as a live counterhypothesis. A second-order test may be warranted only after a bounded trigger, not as default combinatorial search.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Hase et al., Does Localization Inform Editing?, NeurIPS 2023, arXiv:2301.04213
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Causal-tracing localization did not reliably identify the best layer for successful factual editing in the tested language models.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: Local lesion/rescue localization must not be promoted into a claim about the best place to modify the system or about global editability.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Lipsitch, Tchetgen Tchetgen, Cohen, Negative Controls: A Tool for Detecting Confounding and Bias in Observational Studies, Epidemiology 2010, doi:10.1097/EDE.0b013e3181d61eeb
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Negative controls are designed to reproduce relevant sources of bias while excluding the hypothesized causal mechanism, so unexpected non-null effects expose bias or confounding.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: WP806 needs a SHAM/no-op intervention control and an off-target rescue/control that exercises the same intervention plumbing without restoring the target capability.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Kittler et al., RNA interference rescue by bacterial artificial chromosome transgenesis in mammalian tissue culture cells, 2005, PMCID: PMC548992
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Rescue is used to test perturbation specificity; rescue constructs should reproduce the target function without invalidating the original perturbation and ideally operate at physiological expression levels.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: WP806 RESCUE should restore the exact lesioned public capability at the same typed boundary, not inject an alternate high-powered helper path or evaluator-only information.

primary_and_high_quality_sources.source: Yoshihara and colleagues, Necessary and sufficient in biology is not necessarily necessary, 2018, PMCID: PMC6510664
primary_and_high_quality_sources.observed: Loss-of-function and gain-of-function experiments are frequently overinterpreted as matching logical necessity/sufficiency claims even when their experimental propositions differ.
primary_and_high_quality_sources.transfer: WP806 should report bounded intervention dependence/restoration, not global NECESSARY_AND_SUFFICIENT language.

cross_source_supported_design_constraint: Condition identity and intervention target must be sealed before outcome scoring.
NORMAL, LESION and RESCUE must be matched on the same fixture/episode family and differ only at declared intervention boundaries.
Add a SHAM/no-op intervention control that exercises condition machinery without changing the target capability.
Add an off-target/wrong-rescue control where practical to test specificity of the restoration path.
RESCUE must restore the exact public capability/value semantics at the lesioned boundary; it must not introduce evaluator-private information or a stronger alternate mechanism.
Record intervention method and score metric as experiment identity because conclusions can be method-sensitive.
A weak/zero isolated lesion effect remains compatible with redundancy/self-repair/interaction; do not mint irrelevance.

A successful rescue supports specificity of the bounded intervention chain but does not alone establish global necessity, sufficiency, best edit location, cognition superiority or whole-system causality.
counterhypotheses: The current WP806 three-condition scope may already encode enough matching and specificity that sham/off-target controls add no discriminatory value.
Second-order co-lesion tests may overcomplicate a minimal deterministic benchmark and should only activate after a predeclared redundancy/self-repair trigger.

A rescue can appear successful through an alternate compensatory path even when the original target mechanism is not restored; exact boundary equality is therefore more informative than output recovery alone.
